grouped_per16_fused_error.message: active_moe_grouped_per16_fused_contract passed shape/layout checks, but the fused grouped per-16 native-FP4 active expert kernel is not implemented yet. This is the P70 replacement point for a one-boundary kernel that avoids P68's two-stage intermediate tensor.

decision: The grouped_per16_fused backend name is now reserved for the true one-boundary active expert kernel. It must not fall back to P68's two-stage tile reference path.
